latestVersion.changelog:
Generator Video Maker 1.0.0 — initial release.

- Instantly generates 30-second promotional videos from text or uploaded media (MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG up to 500MB).
- Fully automated cloud rendering: no editing software or installations required.
- Simple, anonymous token setup with 100 free credits for new users (7-day expiry).
- Built-in session management keeps your video drafts and timeline state for iterative editing.
- Supports fast export to MP4, MOV, and popular image/audio formats.
- Handles user prompts for credits, export, upload, and video editing actions intelligently.
